<?php
function missing_fallback(): int { echo "F;"; return 9; }
$o = new class {
    public function __isset(string $name): bool {
        echo "I:", $name, ";";
        return false;
    }
    public function __get($name) {
        echo "G:", $name, ";";
        return 0;
    }
};
echo "R:", ($o->missing ?? missing_fallback()), ";";

<?php
function missing_fallback(): int { echo "F;"; return 9; }
$o = new class {
    public function __isset(string $name): bool {
        echo "I:", $name, ";";
        return $name === "yes";
    }
};
echo "N:", ($o->no ?? missing_fallback()), ";";
echo "Y:", ($o->yes ?? missing_fallback()), ";";
